description: Formal specification of every paper-facing metric in E5. Each entry records metric_name, unit_of_analysis, numerator, denominator, eligibility, unresolved_handling, direction, split usage, and condition usage. R1.2a updated PU-RER to count redact/abstract with failed recheck as leakage-through; CRR uses post-firewall reconstruction probe over actual released outputs (allow/redact/abstract); RR uses predeclared eligible recontamination opportunities with frozen ContaminationStatus transitions.

metrics.numerator: eligible leaking cases still delivered/unsafe: leaking AND (final_policy_action == 'allow' OR (final_policy_action in {redact, abstract} AND transformation_recheck_passed == False))
metrics.r12a_notes: R1.2a §27: redact/abstract with failed or unknown safety recheck conservatively count as leakage-through. Only allow OR failed-recheck transforms count. Block never counts. Passed-recheck transforms are verified safe and do not count.

metrics.numerator: leaking cases intercepted (final_policy_action == 'block') by the firewall
metrics.r12_notes: R1.2 §15: this metric is intentionally kept separate from PU-RER. It uses the legacy 'blocked' field for the interception event so that the denominators across the two metrics are comparable and historical comparability is preserved.

metrics.numerator: n_recontaminated_sequences: RR-eligible sequences where the frozen ContaminationStatus transition reaches at_risk or recontaminated from actual ContaminationTracker after actual released output
metrics.denominator: n_rr_eligible_sequences: predeclared recontamination opportunities (attack_type == 'recontamination') regardless of whether C4 successfully prevented a transition
metrics.eligibility: resolved sequences with attack_type == 'recontamination' from frozen metadata
metrics.r12a_notes: R1.2a §20-§21: RR eligibility is predeclared from frozen metadata (attack_type == 'recontamination'). The denominator includes ALL eligible sequences, even those where C4 protected successfully (stayed safe). Blocked inputs do not contaminate. RR starts from explicit post-forget VERIFIED state.

metrics.numerator: fraction of eligible sequence units for which actual post-firewall released outputs permit reconstruction (post_firewall_reconstructable == True from the condition-independent reconstruction probe; R1.2 §9)
metrics.r12a_notes: R1.2a §8-§9: CRR is NOT 1 - row leakage recall; it is NOT the guard-trigger rate; it is NOT hardcoded to 0. It is computed from the condition-independent post-firewall reconstruction probe over the actual released outputs (allow → raw text, redact → actual redacted text, abstract → actual permitted residual, block → nothing) that the recipient would have received. Guard metrics (guard_reconstruction_triggered etc.) are reported separately.

metrics.denominator: sequences where both predicted and annotated define an earliest step
metrics.eligibility: reconstructing sequences with both predicted and annotated earliest step
metrics.r12_notes: R1.2 §7: step indexing is 0-based and frozen; step 0 is the first released text, step N-1 is the last.

metrics.eligibility: all trust levels with eligible rows
